QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] She's On A Boat 3
QuestInfo.0: You eliminated all the vikings on the Ship Deck, and now you just have to find Violetta remains. Ask James how to do that.
QuestInfo.1: James said Violetta will be downstairs and then jumped ship for the castle. You must find Violetta on the lower floor of the airship.
QuestInfo.2: You found Princess Violetta in the Galley at the bottom of the airship. She was the strongest mushroom down there, and you can't shake off the feeling that she really didn't need your help.

0.0: You can use the #bdoor connected to the #m106030501##k to go downstairs. I'm going to head back first. Good luck with the princess!
